sn55.2:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinīpātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || ||
sn55.2:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || ||
sn55.2:2.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ || pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || || 5--6.
sn55.2:2.6: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti || akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 8.
sn55.2:2.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 9.
sn55.2:3.2: idam vatvā Sugato etad avoca satthā || ||
